_comment: Expected wrangler secret-name manifest for the backend Worker (bowtie-content-tool-poc / -dev). NAMES ONLY — never values. 'required' secrets break the app at runtime if absent (checked fatally). 'optional' secrets are allowed but not mandatory. Any DEPLOYED secret name that is in NEITHER list is flagged as unexpected/stale (how RESEND_API_KEY would have been caught). Keep this in sync when adding/removing a backend secret. Consumed by scripts/check-secrets.mjs.
